text: What if a cat bit you, and instead of a trip to the doctor, you got actual cat powers? Let's find out.
Step one: pet a grumpy cat that has clearly, loudly, repeatedly said no.
asr: Step 1, Pedagrumpy Cat that has clearly, loudly, repeatedly said no.

text: Chomp!
Quick reality check: in real life, a cat bite gives you an infection, not superpowers. Cat teeth are tiny needles full of bacteria, so please, see a doctor.
But this is a what-if. So: day one. You wake up, look in the mirror, and... ears! Two brand new ears, right on top of your head.
asr: But this is what if so day one you wake up look in the mirror and ears to brand new ears right on top of your head

text: Also a tail. Nobody asked for the tail. The tail is here anyway.
Power number one: night vision! Cats can see in light about six times dimmer than you need, which is why they can sprint across a dark room without hitting anything.
Behind the eye there's a mirror layer that bounces light back through the eye for a second try. That's also why cat eyes glow in photos.
asr: Behind the eye, there's a mirror layer that bounces light back through the eye for a second try. That's also white cat eyes glow in photos.

text: So at three in the morning, in total darkness, you can finally find the TV remote. True hero stuff.
Next up, power number two: you always land on your feet!
Cats twist in mid-air: head first, then the front legs, then the back, like a spring unwinding. They can do it from a fall of about thirty centimeters, without even thinking.
So you fall off a ladder? Ta-da! Perfect landing. The paint bucket? Not so lucky.
asr: So you fall off a ladder, tada, perfect landing, the paint bucket, not so lucky.

text: Power number three: the jump! A cat can leap up to five times its own height in a single bounce.
You're one point eight meters tall. Times five... that's nine meters. A two-story roof, from standing, with no run-up!
asr: You're 1.8 meters tall, times 5, that's 9 meters, a two-story roof from standing with no run-up.

text: Your neighbors have questions.
Power number four: super hearing! Humans hear sounds up to about twenty thousand hertz. A cat? Up to sixty-four thousand. That's way past anything you've ever heard.
asr: Power number four, superhearing, humans hear sounds up to about 20,000 hertz. A cat up to 64,000. That's way past anything you've ever heard.

text: So now you can hear a mouse in the walls, the neighbor's microwave, and your own fridge humming. All day. Every day.
Power number five: super reflexes! You react in about a quarter of a second. A cat reacts in twenty to seventy milliseconds. That's faster than a blink.
So your arch-enemy, Doctor Woof, sits down with your favorite food: a double cheeseburger. And before he can even say mine... the burger is gone.
asr: So, your archenemy Dr. Woof sits down with your favorite food, a double cheeseburger, and before he can even say mine, the burger is gone.

text: Thirty milliseconds. He didn't even see you move. Delicious. Justice!
But every hero has a weakness. Yours? A tiny red dot.
Doctor Woof switches on a laser pointer, and your cat brain takes over. You chase it up the wall, across the floor, and straight into a lamp.
asr: Dr. Woof switches on a laser pointer and your cat brain takes over. You chase it up the wall across the floor and straight into a lamp.

text: Cats are wired to chase small, fast things, and that makes it really hard to focus. You were in the middle of saving the city. Now you are staring at a wall.
And cat powers come with cat habits.
Habit one: things on edges must fall. Your boss's mug is right on the edge of the desk. You look at it. It looks at you.
You don't know why you did it. You would absolutely do it again.
Habit two: cats can't taste sweet. The sweet-taste gene is broken, so birthday cake now tastes like... wet bread.
And the big one: cats sleep twelve to sixteen hours a day. So do you now.
asr: And the big one, cat sleep 12 to 16 hours a day, so do you now.

text: A superhero shift is eight hours. You are awake for eight hours. Total.
asr: The superhero shift is 8 hours. You are awake for 8 hours total.

text: The city calls for Meow Man. Meow Man is in a box, in a sunbeam. Do not disturb.
asr: City calls for meow man, meow man is in a box in a sunbeam, do not disturb.

text: So, being a cat superhero? Amazing powers, terrible schedule. Next time: what if a dog licked you?
